purpose: The exact identities an M0A probe package must record and be bound to under authority v1.7. Codex's v1.6 operational finding was that Hermes could not bind its M0A package because these values were not operationally closed. Every value here is the value the running code produces; validate_v1_19.py section m0a-binding re-derives each one and fails if any differs or reads as a placeholder.
retention_rule: stdout and stderr are never inlined into a raw frame. When a getter attempt produces either stream, the exact bytes are stored as their own content-addressed record in the RAW layer of the evidence session and the frame carries only stdout_sha256 / stderr_sha256. When nothing was captured both fields are null and the retention rule is NOT_CAPTURED. There is no third option and no truncated copy.
manifest_sha256_note: authority_manifest_sha256 is the sha256 of THIS bundle's FREEZE-MANIFEST.json as frozen; it is deliberately absent from this file so that build -> validate -> manifest -> validate converges. Read it from FREEZE-MANIFEST.json at probe time.

values.boundary_receipt_law: create_session persists a SESSION_BOUNDARY receipt binding the configured root path, device and inode and the session basename, device and inode; it is governed evidence and is re-checked before every authorizing operation
values.root_session_identity_law: the session identity tuple includes the boundary identity digest, so the same bytes under another root or another session-directory inode are a different, invalid session
values.attempt_marker_derivation_law: stored attempt markers are never trusted from filename or content: markers and records must reconcile as a bijection, each derived from the other, and attempt ids are unique in addition to attempt keys
values.active_integrity_law: active_integrity() must be clean before any write and before finalize; an ACTIVE session with an integrity violation is INVALID and can never finalize
values.mode_authority_law: expected mode is derived from entry KIND via the frozen MODE_TABLE, covers the session directory, and is enforced continuously from creation onward
values.filesystem_refusal_vocabulary: FS_NOT_FOUND, FS_EXISTS, FS_NOT_A_DIRECTORY, FS_IS_A_DIRECTORY, FS_SYMLINK_LOOP, FS_PERMISSION_DENIED, FS_NAME_TOO_LONG, FS_CROSS_DEVICE, FS_NOT_EMPTY, FS_NO_SPACE, FS_READ_ONLY, FS_UNSUPPORTED, FS_UNAVAILABLE
values.session_path_identity_law: the session directory basename IS the session_id, exactly (policy A); the verifier recomputes it and refuses SESSION_PATH_MISMATCH on any rename
values.session_identity_tuple: session_id, probe_id, authority_version, authority_manifest_sha256, evidence_store_version, host_name, product, resolve_version, build, library_name, library_uuid, library_root, trusted_shim_sha256, primitive_spec_sha256, schema_registry_sha256, session_dir_basename, boundary_identity_sha256
values.attempt_tuple_law: attempt uniqueness key is (session_id, layer, logical_identity, attempt_id) bound to the record bytes; cross-layer and cross-identity reuse of an attempt id are refused by name. v1.11 (F110-C): markers and authoritative records are a BIJECTION with EXACT cardinality in both directions - exactly one marker per authoritative record and exactly one record per marker. A SECOND attempt id over the same (session_id, layer, logical_identity, content) is refused MARKER_CARDINALITY_VIOLATION at the write, before any marker is persisted, and a persisted many-to-one state is refused by ACTIVE integrity, finalize() and verify(). An M0A package must therefore derive each attempt id from exactly one probe attempt and must never retry the same captured bytes under a new attempt id for the same logical identity; a retry of an unchanged capture is the idempotent same-tuple write.
values.record_key_law: a record's storage name is sha256 over (session_id, layer, logical_identity, content digest); the verifier recomputes it from the record's semantics and compares it to the actual path
values.mode_metadata_law: POSIX file type and permission mode are frozen for every governed file and directory (dirs 0o700, records and attempt markers 0o400, session manifest / inventory / finalization marker 0o444, journal 0o600); no inode, timestamp or owner is recorded
values.root_symlink_refusal_law: the evidence root and the session directory entry are inspected with lstat BEFORE any resolution; a symlink at either refuses ROOT_SYMLINK_REFUSED or SESSION_SYMLINK_REFUSED, and the root device+inode are re-checked on every operation
values.verification_counters: PASS requires missing == 0, unexpected == 0, changed == 0 and semantic_mismatch == 0
values.boundary_recheck_law: v1.11 (F110-A, F110-D): every normative BOUNDARY.json field is independently reconciled before any authorizing operation - schema, evidence_store_version, authority_version and platform_scope against the frozen constants of THIS authority, and root path/device/inode plus session basename/device/inode against a fresh lstat. created_at is INFORMATIONAL_NON_AUTHORIZING. boundary_sha256 is byte integrity over the stored receipt, never semantic truth. Every public authority-bearing method checks the persisted boundary FIRST under the frozen precedence BOUNDARY > SESSION_STATE > MODEL > READ, so a replaced session can never be reported as SESSION_NOT_FINALIZED or answer with live data.
values.inventory_field_vocabulary: attempt_count, authority_version, boundary_identity_sha256, boundary_sha256, closed_world, directories, entries, entry_count, evidence_store_version, finalized_marker_path, inventory_sha256, mode_table, platform_scope, recomputed_model, record_count, schema, self_path, semantic_reconciliation, session_dir_basename, session_id, session_identity_sha256, session_manifest_sha256, total_bytes
values.inventory_field_set_law: v1.11 (F110-B): the top-level INVENTORY field set is EXACT. A missing normative field, an unknown extra semantic field, a duplicate field or a wrong type is a refusal (INVENTORY_FIELD_SET_INVALID), and semantic extension requires an inventory schema version. record_count, entry_count, total_bytes, attempt_count, self_path and finalized_marker_path are recomputed from the independent model and the frozen store layout; total_bytes scope is GOVERNED_ENTRIES_EXCLUDING_INVENTORY_AND_FINALIZATION_MARKER.
values.public_authority_surface: active_integrity, attempts, authority_errors, boundary_receipt, check_boundary, expected_model, finalization_marker, finalize, finalized, get, identity, identity_errors, inventory, manifest, manifest_sha256, put, put_derived, put_json, put_promotion, put_raw, put_review, scan_tree, session_state, verify, verify_summary
values.evidence_set_lifecycle: OPEN -> PREPARED -> VERIFIED; OPEN grants the PREPARER its three record types, PREPARED grants the VERIFIER only BUNDLE_VERIFICATION, VERIFIED grants nothing to anyone
values.principal_law: a principal is '<ROLE>:<actor>' registered in PRINCIPALS.json and stamped by the tool for the ONE role that tool implements. No ACTOR holds two roles. It is a role-bound operational label, NOT an authenticated identity: no key, no signature, no certificate.
values.constructor_functions: evidence_authoring.create_evidence_set, evidence_authoring.add_provisioning_record, evidence_authoring.add_launch_recipe, evidence_authoring.add_read_only_journal, evidence_authoring.mark_prepared, evidence_authoring.add_bundle_verification, evidence_authoring.load_evidence_set, evidence_authoring.workflow_state, evidence_authoring.validate_evidence_set, evidence_authoring.derive_attachment_state (the AUTHORIZING wrapper, which loads through authority_lib.load_governed_evidence_set and calls authority_lib.derive_attachment_state_authorizing)
values.state_derivation_entrypoint: evidence_authoring.derive_attachment_state(session_id) -> authority_lib.load_governed_evidence_set(session_id, active) -> authority_lib.derive_attachment_state_authorizing(target_contract, GovernedEvidenceSet, active) (v1.14: the wrapper no longer calls the diagnostic authority_lib.derive_attachment_state)
values.verifier_action_law: A2V INDEPENDENT BUNDLE VERIFICATION is a DISTINCT named human authorization: it is not part of A2, not part of A1 and not part of M0B. It requires a registered VERIFIER principal whose ACTOR differs from the preparer's, and it may author no record type but BUNDLE_VERIFICATION.
values.bundle_verification_content: authority_version, manifest_sha256, verifier, prepared_by, historical (v1.11) + verification_result, verifier_principal, preparer_principal, verified_provisioning_id, verified_launch_recipe_id, pinned_file_digests (v1.12)
values.bundle_verification_derived_not_supplied: the verifier tool supplies ONLY its own principal; the result, both principals, both verified record ids, the manifest digest and the 9 pinned-file digests are computed by the tool itself
values.verification_result_law: only PASS satisfies the attachment gate; a FAIL record is written for audit and refused by the attachment derivation (#derive_attachment_state_authorizing on the authorizing path; the diagnostic #derive_attachment_state applies the same semantic rule)
values.finalization_lock_law: O_EXCL LOCK file in the document directory recording the holder's principal and pid; atomic sibling-temp + os.replace for every write; prepared_content_sha256 sealed at PREPARED; evidence_set_sha256 sealed at VERIFIED and re-checked on every load; both files become mode 0400. Single-host qualification; no distributed locking is claimed.
values.toctou_law: a BUNDLE_VERIFICATION names the exact provisioning and launch record ids it verified; a record id is a content digest, so editing a verified preparer record breaks the binding and the attachment derivation refuses (#derive_attachment_state_authorizing on the authorizing path; the diagnostic #derive_attachment_state applies the same semantic rule)
values.staleness_law: evidence_authoring.derive_attachment_state refuses a governed document whose evaluated_at is older than MAX_OBSERVATION_AGE_S (3600s) or more than 60s in the future
values.read_only_journal_ownership: PREPARER; PROBE ELIGIBILITY layer (PERMISSIONS.json READ_ONLY_JOURNAL_OPEN). It is not attachment evidence and never substitutes for BUNDLE_VERIFICATION.
values.container_separation_law: Store.v5 carries raw M0A capture evidence and session integrity; the resolveEvidenceSet document carries attachment and provisioning authority. current_session_id is a LABEL naming the Resolve session under evaluation, never a Store.v5 session id, and no Store.v5 session-manifest field belongs in an attachment record.
values.governed_root_caller_selectable: NO - no authorizing function and neither production CLI accepts a root parameter of any name. governed_attachment_root() takes no argument.
values.governed_root_trust_law: the governed root and the session directory are classified by lstat BEFORE any resolution: a symlink at either is ROOT_SYMLINK_REFUSED / SESSION_SYMLINK_REFUSED and never followed. realpath is only ever a later alias check; the module contains no .resolve() call. The root must be absolute, already normalised, an existing directory with mode 0700.
values.governed_location_recheck_law: re-established on EVERY authorizing load - update, verify, finalize and derive - not only at creation. The authorizing derivation also requires the document's authority_root to equal the frozen constant and written_under_production_root to be true.
values.governed_path_refusal_codes: ROOT_NOT_GOVERNED, ROOT_SYMLINK_REFUSED, ROOT_NOT_A_DIRECTORY, ROOT_NOT_FOUND, ROOT_MODE_INVALID, SESSION_SYMLINK_REFUSED, SESSION_NOT_A_DIRECTORY, SESSION_PATH_NOT_GOVERNED, NOT_PRODUCTION_ROOT, SET_LOCATION_MISMATCH, SESSION_ID_INVALID
values.session_id_law: safe basename only: first character alphanumeric, remainder [A-Za-z0-9._-], maximum 128. Rejects empty, separators, .., leading dot, NUL, absolute syntax, drive letters, whitespace and over-length. No traversal is possible through the session id.
values.preparer_library_option: --library-root (renamed from --root in v1.13 so no production CLI carries an option literally called --root; it is the ALREADY-PROVISIONED Resolve Disk library path, a record field, never the evidence root)
values.test_override_module: tools/evidence_authoring_testkit.py, AUTHORITY_CLASS INTERNAL_NON_AUTHORIZING; not imported by either production CLI; refuses to sandbox the frozen root; its documents are refused by the authorizing derivation
values.operational_package_update_required: any prepared M0A/A2 harness must drop --evidence-root and root= entirely, rename --root to --library-root, and expect the frozen attachment root to exist as a 0700 directory before adopt is called (ROOT_NOT_FOUND otherwise).
values.authorizing_eligibility: authority_lib.evaluate_eligibility_authorizing(permissions, request, read_primitives, capabilities, target_contract, GovernedEvidenceSet, active) or evaluate_eligibility_for_session(session_id, ...)
values.governed_evidence_set_loader: authority_lib.load_governed_evidence_set(session_id, active) - the ONLY door to an authorizing attachment or eligibility answer
values.diagnostic_non_authorizing_functions: authority_lib.derive_attachment_state, authority_lib.evaluate_eligibility - DIAGNOSTIC / NON_AUTHORIZING as of v1.14: semantic derivation only, no location authority, no receipt; their output is refused by every authorizing entry point
values.location_receipt_binds: session_id, document_path, workflow_path, governed_root, authority_version, manifest_sha256, document_sha256, workflow_sha256, evidence_snapshot_digest, location_validated
values.location_provenance_law: an authorizing answer requires a GovernedEvidenceSet minted by the core loader, and the receipt is recomputed from the live filesystem on every authorizing call. A dict, a namespace object, a subclass, a precomputed state or a diagnostic result is refused LOCATION_PROVENANCE_MISSING; a stale object is refused LOCATION_RECEIPT_INVALID.
values.location_refusal_codes: ROOT_NOT_GOVERNED, ROOT_SYMLINK_REFUSED, ROOT_NOT_A_DIRECTORY, ROOT_NOT_FOUND, ROOT_MODE_INVALID, SESSION_SYMLINK_REFUSED, SESSION_NOT_A_DIRECTORY, SESSION_PATH_NOT_GOVERNED, SESSION_ID_INVALID, SESSION_NOT_FOUND, DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND, DOCUMENT_SYMLINK_REFUSED, DOCUMENT_NOT_AT_CANONICAL_PATH, SELF_LOCATION_MISMATCH, NOT_PRODUCTION_ROOT, LOCATION_PROVENANCE_MISSING, LOCATION_RECEIPT_INVALID, WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND, WORKFLOW_SYMLINK_REFUSED, WORKFLOW_NOT_A_REGULAR_FILE, WORKFLOW_NOT_AT_CANONICAL_PATH, GOVERNED_EVIDENCE_INVALID, EVIDENCE_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH, GOVERNED_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, RECEIPT_BINDING_DRIFT, LOCATION_AUTHORITY_INVALID
values.function_classification_artifact: AUTHORITY-FUNCTION-CLASSES.json (generated from authority_lib.AUTHORITY_SURFACE; ONE function -> ONE current authority class, with the authorizing and diagnostic slot inventories and the runtime-lookup law)
values.receipt_binding_artifact: EVIDENCE-SET-WORKFLOW.json#core_authority.receipt and AUTHORITY-FUNCTION-CLASSES.json#receipt_binding - both generated from authority_lib.receipt_binding_publication(), so the published field set IS the runtime field set
values.receipt_bound_fields: session_id, document_path, workflow_path, governed_root, authority_version, manifest_sha256, document_sha256, workflow_sha256, evidence_snapshot_digest, location_validated
values.receipt_field_semantics_published: field, source, normative, in_digest, revalidated_live, consumed_by_authorizing_core - per field, in both artifacts
values.operational_package_update_required_v116: an M0A/A2 harness must derive the receipt field set and every function's authority class from AUTHORITY-FUNCTION-CLASSES.json and EVIDENCE-SET-WORKFLOW.json#core_authority.receipt, NOT by reading Python and NOT from any prose. The published receipt binding gained three fields it always bound at runtime - workflow_path, workflow_sha256 and evidence_snapshot_digest - so a harness that recomputes the receipt from the v1.15 publication computed it over seven fields and would have disagreed with the authority; recompute over all ten, in the published order.
values.authorizing_evidence_object_law: an authorizing answer requires a GovernedEvidenceSet minted by authority_lib.load_governed_evidence_set. It is IMMUTABLE (frozen slots, bytes not a parsed object, evidence_set is a reparsing read-only property) and NOT copyable or picklable. There is exactly one evidence authority input per authorizing call.
values.immutable_snapshot_law: THE EXACT BYTES VALIDATED AS GOVERNED EVIDENCE ARE THE EXACT BYTES CONSUMED BY AUTHORIZING DERIVATION. authority_lib.governed_consume() revalidates the location, re-reads both authority files no-follow, requires the live digests to equal the minted ones and the carrier's bytes to digest identically, strict-parses those exact bytes, schema-validates them, checks the canonical snapshot digest bound into the receipt, and returns the object the authorizing path consumes.
values.authorizing_transaction_eligibility: authority_lib.validate_transaction_set_authorizing / commit_eligibility_authorizing over a GovernedEvidenceSet; plan-time eligibility is evaluated by evaluate_eligibility_authorizing. The bare-dict validate_transaction_set / commit_eligibility pair is PROVISIONAL_UNTIL_M3 and NON-AUTHORIZING.
values.malformed_object_refusal_code: GOVERNED_EVIDENCE_INVALID (a malformed governed carrier fails closed; no raw Python exception escapes a public authorizing boundary)
values.missing_provenance_refusal_code: GOVERNED_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED (an authorizing transaction/commit path handed evidence with no governed provenance)
values.snapshot_mismatch_refusal_code: EVIDENCE_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH (the consumed semantic object is not the parse of the validated bytes)
values.operational_package_update_required_v115: an M0A/A2 harness must (1) obtain evidence ONLY from authority_lib.load_governed_evidence_set(session_id, active) and never construct, copy, pickle or mutate a GovernedEvidenceSet - assignment to any field now raises a frozen refusal; (2) read authorizing results by the authorizing=true flag, the location_receipt and the new evidence_snapshot_digest; (3) call authority_lib.commit_eligibility_authorizing / validate_transaction_set_authorizing for any transaction or commit decision, because the bare-dict pair is no longer authorizing; and (4) expect WORKFLOW.json to be refused as symlink, FIFO, socket, device or directory exactly as EVIDENCE-SET.json is.
values.operational_package_update_required_v114: an M0A/A2 harness must not call the DIAGNOSTIC / NON_AUTHORIZING authority_lib.derive_attachment_state or the DIAGNOSTIC / NON_AUTHORIZING authority_lib.evaluate_eligibility for any decision. Load through authority_lib.load_governed_evidence_set(session_id, active) - or simply call evidence_authoring.derive_attachment_state(session_id), which now routes through it - and read the authorizing=true flag and the location_receipt from the result. A harness that passes a bare evidence-set dict now receives CONFLICT / eligible=false with LOCATION_AUTHORITY_INVALID.
values.library_adoption_law: tools/a2_prepare.py adopt records the identity of a library that ALREADY exists physically (name, Disk kind, absolute root, canonical UUID, provisioned_by) and matches it against the target contract. It never creates, renames or deletes a Resolve library, and destructive recreation is never required.
values.closed_world_verification: FINALIZED sessions are a closed world: the inventory records every governed file and directory, and verification requires missing == 0, unexpected == 0, changed == 0
